# Java Audiveris 5.11 (Temurin JDK 25) HEADS scanner-context oracle.

# Private Scanner instances are constructed in processStaff order, but lookup
# is never called. Seed and range construction must have identical static geometry.
# Competitor/bar Area slicing is intentionally deferred to a later sub-gate.
#

# over every inclusive x in the declared interval. Row summaries are FNV-1a-64
# over UTF-8 canonical records with a trailing newline.
#
# Generate one target per fresh JVM: chula, allegretto, batuque, carmen,
# cucaracha, hove, zizi, BachInvention5.
